s18mmia6.title: Stages of the second birth
steps: Immaculate conception (ἄμωμος σύλληψις), ineffable, below senses and mind
Gestation (κυοφορία) of logos and virtue, losing veils while being nourished
Labour and birth (γέννα) 'suddenly', with a midwife-teacher

x1fub4jc.author: Plato
x1fub4jc.label: When the flood calms
x1fub4jc.translation: but when the flood of growth and nutriment abates, and the courses of the soul, calming down, go their own way and become steadier as time goes on, then the several circles return to their natural form, and their revolutions are corrected, and they call the same and the other by their right names, and make the possessor of them to become a rational being. And if these combine in him with any true nurture or education, he attains the fulness and health of the perfect man, and escapes the worst disease of all;
x1fub4jc.reading: The soul's motions "take advantage of the calm" (γαλήνη), a phrase she loves: judgment of same and other becomes right and one is on the road to φρόνησις. Following Proclus, turbulence disturbs the soul's revolutions but never its essence, so ἀταραξία is revealed rather than produced.
